fusions.name: Last Morsel
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 20 damage and devours every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Gorging Swarm
fusions.desc: A swarm that deals 28 poison damage, ignoring resistances, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Passed Comb
fusions.desc: Restores 16 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Spoils Carried Home
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. The effect grows 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 8 seconds.
